description: This line plot compares the Accuracy@1 (%) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, across varying numbers of child nodes, which represent tree width. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick marks labeled at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 5. The plot displays two lines: the GPT-4o model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, and the Claude-3.5-Sonnet model is represented by a dashed light blue line with cross markers. The GPT-4o line starts at 24.4% accuracy at 1 child node, rises to 28.9% at 3 child nodes, peaks at 34.4% at 5 child nodes, and then declines to 31.1% at 7 child nodes. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line starts at 26.7% accuracy at 1 child node, rises slightly to 27.8% at 3 child nodes, then declines steadily to 24.4% at 5 child nodes and further to 20.0% at 7 child nodes.
